authorization for a new group-01 dataset if no official mapping exists

administrator_workstream.acceptance: Complete readback proves the exact official configuration; OR and shipping point 1010 are not substitutes.

administrator_workstream.acceptance: $metadata returns HTTP 200 and scoped read/create/readback contracts are available.

administrator_workstream.request: Approve exact tax, valuation, account-determination and training-stock values separately.
administrator_workstream.acceptance: Named owners provide exact values and scopes; no values are inferred from 1710 or unrelated reference objects.

administrator_workstream.request: Provide warehouse/EWM 1010 and participant sessions/catalogs S4600-01 and S4615-01.
administrator_workstream.acceptance: Read-only smoke checks prove the warehouse applications and required Fiori catalogs are accessible.

administrator_workstream.acceptance: Separate written resolution and readback; no automatic ML or global-currency change.

execution_order_after_decisions: Freeze official source/version and resolve logical identities
Complete non-FI customer and product master payloads
Obtain owner approvals bound to exact fingerprints
Create or extend one object at a time with fresh lookup and independent readback
Have administrators establish organizational and FI/MM dependencies
Perform environment smoke checks only; do not pre-execute exercise documents

current_gate.reason: Every remaining operation lacks at least one exact owner decision, mandatory value, organizational prerequisite or new fingerprint approval.
current_gate.next_human_input: Exact Tax, Customer Master and Product Master owner decisions for the named mandatory fields. Administrator involvement is deferred until one consolidated implementation ticket is ready.
